title: Fix Fixture Load Node Channels
description: When loading a procedural fixture, nodes show single in/out channels instead of operator-specific ports (e.g. cut a/b). Root cause: loadFixtureJson recreates FlowHost and clears kind_infos.
summary: Loading a procedural fixture reset FlowHost and cleared kind_infos, so neuron_io_layout fell back to generic in/out ports. Added FlowHost::replace_fixture to swap fixture content while preserving operator metadata; loadFixtureJson now uses it. neuron_io_layout also falls back to persisted inputPorts when kind metadata is unavailable. Fixture sphere-cut-with-torus uses inputPorts camelCase; serde accepts input_ports alias. WASM rebuilt; flow and procedural play tests pass.
